result.detail: No tool was run by this seat. All checks named in the evidence requirements are for the platform to run. A formal_spec (apb_regs.sby) is submitted even though the expected outputs list only rtl_source and testbench. The reason is that interface spec section 7 and microarchitecture section 6 both require the formal proof, and the properties live in the RTL as the microarchitecture prescribes. Submitting it brings in the formal.run and formal.cover requirements. If the reviewer prefers, it can be dropped without touching the RTL, because the FORMAL block is excluded from lint, simulation and synthesis. The failure-path testbench apb_regs_tb_fail.v in the microarchitecture verification plan is not produced here. A second testbench in the same source list would add a second top-level module to the simulation sources; I recommend handling it as a separate task. Under Verilator, the first $error may stop the run before the verdict prints. A run that stops that way still counts as failed. The testbench is written to avoid width-mismatch warnings, because Verilator treats those as fatal by default.
